settings.title: Settings
settings.profileBlurb: Shown on your shelf, in the diary, and next to the club pick.

settings.importBlurb: Upload a Goodreads library export CSV. Exclusive shelves map to Want to read, Reading, and Finished; ratings and read dates come along. Each title is looked up in the catalog, so a large export can take a while. It keeps running if you leave this page. Rows we cannot match are skipped.

vote.title: Next-up vote
vote.blurb: Everyone gets one vote and can change it any time. Voting does not change the current pick: an admin confirms the winner, which replaces the pick for the whole club.
vote.noneBody: Open any book and choose “Nominate for next up”. Books more than one of you wants to read are a good place to start.
vote.confirmBlurb: This ends the vote and replaces the current pick for everyone in the club.
vote.blurbAdmin: Everyone gets one vote and can change it any time. When you're ready, confirm the winner: it replaces the club pick for everyone.
vote.deadlineBlurb: At the deadline the vote closes by itself and the leading book becomes the club pick.
vote.suggestionsBlurb: Books members want to read, ranked by how many want them and how they match past picks.

newClub.lede: A club reads one book at a time. You can rename it later.
newClub.name: Club name

invites.heading: Invites
invites.blurb: A single-use invite lets one person in and lasts 30 days. A link works for anyone who has it for 7 days. Withdraw either any time.

clubSettings.deleteBlurb: This deletes {club} for everyone: its picks, votes, discussion and invites. Shelves and diaries stay with their readers.

diaryPage.empty: Nothing written yet. Open a book on your shelf and note down a thought.

editions.blurb: Your shelf and your real bookshelf then use its pages and cover.

editions.isbnHint: On the back cover or the copyright page. Optional.
editions.ownTitleHint: Only if it differs from the book's title, as for a translation.
editions.addSomething: Fill in at least one field.

merge.blurb: If the catalog has “{title}” twice, find the other entry. An admin checks it and joins the two.
merge.otherPlaceholder: Title, author, or a link to its page

verify.notMine: Not your account, or you did not ask for this? Close this page and nothing changes.
verify.doneBody: Thanks. Password reset links go to this address now.
verify.failedHint: Links work once and expire. Ask for a new one under Settings → Email address.

forgot.sentBody: If an account has confirmed {email}, a link is on its way. It works for an hour.
forgot.noEmailNote: Without a confirmed address on the account there is no reset link. Ask a club admin to help, or sign in and add an address under Settings.

reset.lede: Choose a new password. Every device signed in to your account is signed out.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.

emailPrompt.title: Add an email address
emailPrompt.body: Your account has no email address yet. With one you can reset your password if you ever forget it.

account.noEmail: No address yet. Without one you cannot reset your password.
account.checkInbox: Open the link we sent to confirm it.
account.emailHint: Your current address stays until the new one is confirmed.
account.emailSent: If {email} can be used, a confirmation link is on its way.
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Your other devices are signed out.
account.passwordSaved: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.
account.notificationsBlurb: What you want to hear about once the apps can notify you.
account.notify_note: New notes on the club pick
account.deleteBlurb: This deletes your account with your shelf, notes, quotes and posts. Where someone replied to a post of yours, an empty “Deleted account” entry keeps their reply in place. Clubs where you are the only member go too. Download your data first if you want to keep it.
account.ownedClubs: You own these clubs, and others are in them. Hand them over or delete them first:

editRequest.title: Correct this book's details
editRequest.blurb: Change what is wrong about “{title}”. An admin checks it before everyone sees it.
editRequest.sent: Thanks. An admin will look at it.
editRequest.nothingChanged: Change at least one field first.

admin.title: Admin
admin.lede: What readers asked to change or reported, and invites for the closed beta.
admin.intro: What readers asked to change or reported, invites for the closed beta, and suspended accounts.
admin.settingsBlurb: You run this instance: corrections, cover photos, merges and reported covers wait for you.
admin.requestsBlurb: Corrections of books and editions, cover photos that would replace a cover, and books entered twice. Approving applies it, and no catalog source overwrites it later.
admin.bookGone: This book is no longer in the catalog.
admin.rejectNote: Why not? (the reader does not see this yet)
admin.reportsBlurb: Covers readers reported. Taking one down removes the picture everywhere, for good; keeping it closes the report.
admin.reportsIntro: Covers, profile pictures and books readers added, as readers reported them. Removing takes a picture down everywhere, or withdraws what a reader typed, for good; keeping closes the report. The reporters hear the decision by mail, and whoever's content was removed hears why.
admin.alreadyRemoved: This picture was already taken down.

removeBlurb.avatar: The picture disappears from the profile and everywhere else, and the same file cannot be uploaded again.
removeBlurb.work: The title becomes “[removed]”, and the authors, description and subjects go, for good. Shelves, posts and picks keep the book.
removeBlurb.edition: The edition loses its own title, subtitle and publisher for good, and shows its book's title.

admin.takeDownBlurb: The picture disappears from every book and edition that shows it, and no refresh brings it back.
admin.invitesBlurb: While sign-up needs an invite, these let someone create an account without joining a club.
admin.inviteDefaults: With both empty, the invite is for one person and lasts 30 days.
admin.freshInvite: Send this link to the people it is for:
admin.pastInvites: {n} used or ended invite | {n} used or ended invites

users.title: Suspended accounts
users.blurb: A suspended account cannot sign in, and every session and app token it had ends at once. What it wrote stays. Lifting the suspension lets it sign in again.
users.manual: It can no longer export or delete its data itself: its owner writes to the contact address, and the operator follows §7 of docs/legal/takedown.md.
users.name: Username
users.confirmBlurb: {name} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you lift the suspension.

edit.title: Edit this book as admin
edit.blurb: Your values for “{title}” apply at once, and no catalog source overwrites them later.
edit.saved: Saved. Everyone sees the new values now.

admin.closedOnArrival: Closed on arrival: the picture was already taken down

stats.title: Reports decided in the last {days} days

gone.avatar: No longer online: its owner replaced or deleted the picture, so there is nothing left to take down.
gone.work: Merged into this book since it was reported, so the reported text no longer shows on its own. If this book took some of it over, correct it with “Edit as admin”.

takeDownForm.notAPicture: That is not the address of a picture or a book page.
takeDownForm.future: The notice cannot have arrived in the future.
takeDownForm.done: Picture taken down and the notice recorded
takeDownForm.coversOnly: This is not a book cover (a profile picture, say). A notice about it cannot be recorded yet, so nothing was taken down. You can take it down without a record.
takeDownForm.doneWithoutRecord: Picture taken down. The notice was not recorded.
takeDownForm.failed: Could not take the picture down
